title: The art of counterpoint: a Mazzola-type model of three-voice first-species counterpoint
summary: In this paper, we extend Mazzola's model of two-voice counterpoint to three-voice first-species counterpoint. The construction combines a fiber product over a shared lower voice with a harmonic mask and a two-stage maximization defining admitted successors. For the Fuxian dichotomy, we compute the successor relation and investigate connections with the Riemann dichotomy and neo-Riemannian transformations.
